topic.title: What lies under Grand Central Terminal: the shuttle, the 4/5/6, the 7, the secret M42 power basement and Grand Central Madison's deep platforms

title: How Deep Does Grand Central Go?
description:
How deep does Grand Central go?
Below New York's most famous station run the shuttle, two more subway lines, a secret power basement and the deep platforms of Grand Central Madison.
Sources: Wikipedia, ASCE, MTA (2026).
Depths from published sources. Cutaway illustrations, not to scale.
cta: Which station should we dive under next? Comment
